newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites bids for 8.4 pct of Tonsil.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites bids for 8.4 pct of Tonsil.

text.p: The Polish Treasury Ministry, the former privatisation ministry, is inviting bids for a 8.39 percent stake in speaker systems maker Tonsil SA, the ministry said in a newspaper advertisement on Tuesday.
It said it was offering to sell 175,000 common shares already approved for public trade at a nominal value of four zlotys each. The transaction would be done off the bourse.

The deadline for bids is noon November 15. The treasury, which currently holds 26.78 percent of Tonsil stock, said offers from companies not directly competing with Tonsil on the market would be preferred. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
